newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean corporate bond issues to rise in June.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean corporate bond issues to rise in June.

text.p: The Korea Securities Dealers Association on Friday approved applications by companies to issue 2.81 trillion won worth of corporate bonds in June, up from 2.46 trillion won in May.
Companies plan to issue 1.69 trillion won worth of bonds to raise general operating funds, accounting for 60.2 percent of the total, the association said in a statement.

Bonds worth 360 billion won, or 12.8 percent of the total, will be issued to raise funds for facility investment. Those worth 759.45 billion won, or 27 percent of the total, will be for repayments of bonds maturing in June, it said.
